answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 48 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in ivory, queued in zenith, and vault publishes the wait time. A farm of 362 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2014 identities would post 3586 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
